title: stenostomum heteroneurum
intro: Stenostomum heteroneurum, commonly known as the "Heteroneurum Stenostomum" or "Red Stemmed Stenostomum", is a flowering plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help alleviate conditions like fever, skin infections, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Stenostomum heteroneurum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
